description: Remove a file from a space's Files to Trash and off its pins; restoring it in the app within 30 days pins it again. A picture, clip or sound (media_id) is refused while the space collects it, names it as an @element or has it on a roll prompt, and the refusal says where.

media_id.description: Instead: a picture, clip or sound from list_space media.

space_file_id.description: An uploaded document from list_space files.

space_id.description: The space whose Files hold it.

name: delete_file
title: Delete file
